subject: executor: fix data race in hash join v2 (#55525)
summary: Reviewed first-parent diff in `pkg/executor/join`: adds endian-aware bit masks and a conditional atomic-read path for nullmap bits to avoid concurrent `atomic.StoreUint32` used-flag updates racing with per-column null checks during hash join v2 build-row materialization. The only Blocker/High candidate identified (index-out-of-range in the new thread-safe nullmap read path for `columnIndex==31`) was fixed later on `upstream/master` by `41c99261bf` (PR #55864), and no other Blocker/High issues remain in the scoped executor changes.
